```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(fgsea)
library(data.table)

result_folder = "../../../../Results/PolyclonalCultures/RNA"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

```

```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"))
norm_counts = read.table(file.path(result_folder, "Normalized_expression_data.txt"), sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
colnames(norm_counts) = gsub("Row.names", "Geneid", colnames(norm_counts))

ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Group == "Control", ifelse(ed$Site=="small intestinal", "SI", "Stomach control"), ed$Group)
ed$Condition = factor(ed$Condition, levels=c("Stomach control","Non-IM", "IM","SI"))
```

```{r}
anno_colors = list("Condition"=c("Stomach control"="lightgreen","SI"="red","IM"="orange","Non-IM"="blue"), "Site"=c("Antrum"="pink","small intestinal"="red1","Corpus"="yellow","Angular incisure"="red3"))
```


# Known IM/intestinal markers


```{r, fig.width=12}
cond_order = c("Normal Antrum","Non-IM","IM","SI")
sel_genes_2 = c("SOX2","TFF1","TFF2","GKN1","MUC5AC","CDX2","HNF4A","VIL1","CD44","AQP5")
nc_mat_selected <- fpkm_mat[subset(gene_anno, GeneSymbol %in% sel_genes_2)$Geneid,]
rownames(nc_mat_selected) <- gene_anno[rownames(nc_mat_selected), "GeneSymbol"]

dd = reshape2::melt(nc_mat_selected)
colnames(dd) = c("gene","sample", "expression")
dd$sample = gsub("^X","", dd$sample)
dd = as.data.table(merge(dd, ed[, c("sampleID","Patient","Condition")], by.x="sample", by.y="sampleID"))

dd$Condition <- ifelse(dd$Condition == "Stomach control","Normal Antrum", as.character(dd$Condition))

dd1 <- subset(dd, gene %in% sel_genes_2)
dd1$gene <- factor(dd1$gene, levels = sel_genes_2)
dd1$Condition <- factor(dd1$Condition, levels = cond_order)
ggplot(dd1, aes(x=Condition, fill=Condition, y=expression)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .1)) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size=20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
  labs(y="FPKM")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
sel_genes = c("GKN1","GKN2","PGC","MUC5AC","MUC6","TFF3","VIL1","CDX1","CDX2","ISX", "MUC2", "SPINK4","ITLN1","TFF2","DEFA5", "TFF1", "REG4", "LRIG1", "OLFM4","AQP8","CLCA4","CA1","HOXA13","APOA1","APOA4","HOXC11","SOX2","SOX21", "AXIN2","ALPI", "TREH", "ANPEP", "SI")

sel_samples = rownames(ed)
nc_selected = subset(norm_counts, GeneSymbol %in% sel_genes )
nc_mat_selected = as.matrix(nc_selected[,sel_samples])
nc_mat_selected = nc_mat_selected + rnorm(ncol(nc_mat_selected) * nrow(nc_mat_selected), 0,0.01)
rownames(nc_mat_selected) = nc_selected$GeneSymbol
col_anno = ed[, c("Condition","Site"), drop=F]
#rownames(col_anno) = paste0("X", ed$Library.number)
breaks_new=c(-10,-5,-3,seq(-2,2,by=4/94),3,5,10)
pheatmap(nc_mat_selected, scale="row", main="Known IM markers" , annotation_col = col_anno, breaks=breaks_new, labels_col = ed[colnames(nc_mat_selected), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_colors)

tmp = nc_mat_selected[,order(ed[colnames(nc_mat_selected), "Remark"])]
pheatmap(tmp, scale="row", main="Known IM markers" , annotation_col = col_anno, breaks=breaks_new, labels_col = ed[colnames(tmp), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_colors, cluster_cols = F)

tmp = nc_mat_selected[,order(nc_mat_selected["CDX2",])]
pheatmap(tmp, scale="row", main="Known IM markers" , annotation_col = col_anno, breaks=breaks_new, labels_col = ed[colnames(tmp), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_colors, cluster_cols = F)

tmp = nc_mat_selected[,order(nc_mat_selected["CDX1",])]
pheatmap(tmp, scale="row", main="Known IM markers" , annotation_col = col_anno, breaks=breaks_new, labels_col = ed[colnames(tmp), "Remark"], annotation_colors = anno_colors, cluster_cols = F)


```

```{r}
sel_genes = c("CDX2","CDX1","VIL1","ALPI", "ANPEP", "SI","AQP8","CLCA4","CA1","MUC2","DEFA5","SOX2","PGC","GKN1")
sel_samples = rownames(subset(ed, !Condition %in% c("Stomach control")))
nc_selected = subset(norm_counts, GeneSymbol %in% sel_genes )
nc_mat_selected = as.matrix(nc_selected[,sel_samples])
nc_mat_selected = nc_mat_selected + rnorm(ncol(nc_mat_selected) * nrow(nc_mat_selected), 0,0.01)
rownames(nc_mat_selected) = nc_selected$GeneSymbol
col_anno = ed[, c("Condition","Patient")]
#rownames(col_anno) = paste0("X", ed$Library.number)

```

```{r, fig.width=16}
dd = reshape2::melt(nc_mat_selected)
colnames(dd) = c("gene","sample", "expression")
#dd$sample = gsub("^X","", dd$sample)
dd = as.data.table(merge(dd, ed[, c("sampleID","Patient","Condition")], by.x="sample", by.y="sampleID"))

dd$gene = factor(dd$gene, levels=sel_genes)
dd$Condition = factor(dd$Condition, levels=c("SI","IM","Non-IM"))

ddt = as.data.table(dd)[, .(mean=mean(expression), sd=sd(expression), n=.N), by=c("gene","Condition")]
ddt[, sd:=ifelse(is.na(sd),0,sd)]
ddt[, sem:=1.96*sd/sqrt(n)]
ddt[, ymin:=mean-sem]
ddt[, ymax:=mean+sem]
ggplot(ddt, aes(x=gene, fill=Condition, y=mean)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position = "dodge") + 
  theme(text = element_text(size=20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=ymin, ymax=ymax), position = position_dodge2(), size=1.2) + 
  labs(y="Mean normalized expression", title="Gut and stomach markers in Zhengzhou cohort", x="") + theme(text=element_text(size=24), axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, size=24))
```
